cases.name: Heather Nicole Kullorn
cases.about: She had just completed the 6th grade at Blow Middle School.
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE UNSOLVED; MISSING PERSON CASE
cases.narrative:
She disappeared while babysitting at her mother's friend's apartment in the 1600 block of Yale Ave in Richmond Heights, MO. Heather was staying in an apartment of her mother's friends, Dana Madden and Christopher Herbert. While there, she was babysitting their two-month-old. When Heather went missing, it was reported that Herbert was out and Madden was working a night shift. 

Reportedly, a neighbor observed an unknown male individual carrying a child about Heather's age out of the apartment around 2:00 a.m. The child's upper body was wrapped in a blanket. At about 5:00 a.m., authorities were called, and they discovered that a white comforter with a floral design was also missing from the apartment. The baby was found unattended, and blood was discovered in the apartment. A DNA test confirmed the blood was Heather’s.
